privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly, including name, email address, and payment information during account registration and checkout. We also collect usage data such as pages visited and interactions with the platform.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Your information is used to process orders, deliver digital products, send order confirmations, provide member dashboard access, and improve our platform. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: 3. Payment Security
sections.content: Payment information is processed exclusively by our payment partners (Mercado Pago and PayPal). We do not store your full card details on our servers. All transactions are SSL encrypted.

sections.title: 4. Cookies
sections.content: We use strictly necessary cookies for authentication, session integrity, and security. Analytics and marketing cookies are off by default and only fire after you explicitly accept them via the cookie banner. To review every category we use, update your choices, or revoke consent, visit our Cookie Policy page. Browser settings remain a backstop, but the in-app preferences are the primary, granular control.

sections.title: 5. Data Sharing
sections.content: We may share limited information with payment processors, email service providers, and analytics services strictly necessary to operate the platform. These partners are contractually bound to protect your data.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
sections.content: Account data is retained as long as your account is active. Order records are kept for legal and accounting purposes. You may request data deletion from your dashboard or by contacting us, subject to applicable legal requirements.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. You may also opt out of marketing communications at any time using the unsubscribe link in emails. See the Privacy Notice below for how to exercise these rights under Mexican law.

sections.title: 8. Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encrypted storage, HTTPS enforcement, and access controls. However, no online transmission is 100% secure.

sections.title: 9. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our platform is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us data, please contact us immediately.

sections.title: 10. Contact Us
sections.content: For privacy-related inquiries or data requests, contact us at hello@mustaphaukizuru.com.

notice.title: Privacy Notice (Aviso de Privacidad Integral)
notice.intro: This notice is issued in compliance with articles 15 to 17 of Mexico's Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP) and its Regulations. It applies to every user of mustaphaukizuru.com, wherever they are located.

sections.title: A. Identity and address of the data controller
sections.content: The party responsible for processing your personal data (responsable) is Mustapha Ukizuru, operating as mustaphaukizuru.com, with address for notices at Tlalnepantla de Baz, Estado de México, Mexico. Contact for all privacy matters: hello@mustaphaukizuru.com.

sections.title: B. Personal data we collect
sections.content: Depending on how you use the platform we collect: account data (name, email, phone, company, avatar, sign-in provider); billing data and addresses, including your RFC or other tax ID when you ask for an invoice; order and payment history (amounts, currency, gateway, payment status — never full card numbers); consultation bookings (date, time zone, notes you add); client-project records and files you share with us; support tickets and messages; product reviews; newsletter subscription status; and technical data collected through cookies and analytics (IP address, device and browser, pages visited) as described in the Cookie Policy. We do not request sensitive personal data as defined by law.

sections.title: C. Primary purposes
sections.content: We process your data to: create and manage your account; process orders, payments, invoices and refunds; deliver digital products and services you purchased; schedule and hold consultations; manage client projects; answer support requests; issue tax receipts when required; keep the platform secure and prevent fraud; and comply with legal obligations. These purposes are necessary for the relationship between you and us.

sections.title: D. Secondary purposes
sections.content: Only if you agree, we also use your data to: send you the newsletter and marketing emails; measure campaign performance and personalise recommendations; and publish reviews you submit. You may decline these purposes at any time, without affecting the primary services, by unsubscribing from emails, changing your cookie preferences, or writing to hello@mustaphaukizuru.com.

sections.title: E. Transfers of personal data
sections.content: Your data is shared only with providers that need it to deliver the service, under contracts that oblige them to keep it confidential: Mercado Pago and PayPal (payment processing); Google (Google Calendar and Google Meet for bookings, and Google Sign-In if you use it); our transactional email provider (order and account emails); and Hostinger (hosting and database infrastructure). Some of these providers process data outside Mexico. No other transfer is made without your consent, except where the law requires it (art. 37 LFPDPPP).

sections.title: F. ARCO rights, revocation of consent and limitation of use
sections.content: You have the right to Access your personal data, Rectify it when inaccurate, request its Cancellation, and Oppose its processing (ARCO rights), as well as to revoke the consent you have given us and to limit the use or disclosure of your data. From your member dashboard (Profile → Privacy & data) you can download a copy of everything we hold about you and delete your account on your own. For any other request, email hello@mustaphaukizuru.com with: your full name, a copy of an official ID or the account email we can verify, a clear description of the right you wish to exercise and the data concerned, and any documents supporting the request.

sections.title: G. Response time
sections.content: We will answer your request within a maximum of 20 business days from the date we receive it, in line with article 32 of the LFPDPPP, and, if it is upheld, we will act on it within the following 15 business days. Responses are sent by email to the address on file. Order and invoice records must be kept for the period required by Mexican tax law, so deletion of an account anonymises your identity while those records are preserved.

sections.title: H. Competent authority
sections.content: If you believe your right to data protection has been infringed, you may file a complaint with the National Institute for Transparency, Access to Information and Protection of Personal Data (INAI) at inai.org.mx.

sections.title: I. Cookies and tracking technologies
sections.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences and, only with your consent, measure use of the site and campaigns. Section 4 above and the Cookie Policy describe every category and how to disable it.

sections.title: J. Changes to this notice
sections.content: We may update this notice to reflect legal changes or new features. The current version is always published at this page and the "Last updated" date at the top changes with every revision. When a change affects the purposes for which we process your data we will notify you by email or by a notice on the platform before it takes effect.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: Clear, fair, and enforceable, for digital products and consulting services.

headline.title: Our policy in one line
headline.body: Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase, provided the digital product has not been downloaded. Once any file from an order is downloaded, that item becomes non-refundable.

eligible.title: Refunds Are Available When
items: The request is made within 14 days of the original purchase date.
No file from the order has been downloaded yet (verified via download logs).
A duplicate charge was made due to a payment processing error.
The digital product is materially different from its public description, or a defect prevents normal use and our team cannot resolve it within 48 hours.
A consulting service was not delivered as outlined in the signed service agreement.

ineligible.title: Refunds Are Not Available When
items: Any file from the order has been downloaded. Once accessed, the digital product is considered consumed.
The request is made more than 14 days after the original purchase date.
A change of mind after the product was downloaded, viewed, or used.
Incompatibility with third-party software, devices, or environments not specified in the product description.
Consulting hours that have already been delivered, or service packages that have been partially consumed.
Subscription renewals or recurring charges where the renewal notice was sent in advance.

steps.label: Open a support ticket
steps.descSuffix: with your order number and the reason. If you don't have an account, email

steps.label: Eligibility review
steps.desc: Our team checks the order against the policy above, including download logs, and replies within 3 business days.

steps.label: Decision
steps.desc: If approved, the refund is issued to the original payment method. If declined, you receive a written explanation referencing the policy section that applies.

steps.label: Funds returned
steps.desc: Approved refunds settle on your original payment method (PayPal or MercadoPago) within 5–10 business days. Bank timelines may extend this.

steps.label: Access revoked
steps.desc: On any approved refund, whether partial or full, download access for the refunded items is immediately revoked. Existing downloaded copies must be deleted by the customer.

chargebacks.title: Before disputing a charge with your bank
chargebacks.body: We resolve every legitimate refund request directly. Initiating a chargeback before contacting us delays resolution and incurs processor fees on both sides. Please reach out first; we respond within 3 business days. In the event of a chargeback, we provide payment processors with our policy, your acceptance at checkout, and the full download log as evidence.

spanishSummary.title: Resumen en español (México · PROFECO)
spanishSummary.body: De acuerdo con el Artículo 56 de la Ley Federal de Protección al Consumidor, el consumidor cuenta con cinco días hábiles para revocar una compra a distancia, siempre que el producto digital no haya sido descargado o consumido. Una vez descargado, el producto se considera entregado y consumido, por lo que no procede el reembolso. Para servicios de consultoría parcialmente entregados, el reembolso se calcula sobre las horas no consumidas. Las solicitudes deben dirigirse a {{email}} dentro de los 14 días posteriores a la compra.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Plain-language guide to how this site uses cookies and how you stay in control.
cookies.resetClick: Click below to reset and choose again.
cookies.noChoiceYet: You have not made a choice yet; the consent banner will be shown shortly.

sections.title: 1. What cookies are
sections.content: Cookies are small text files placed on your device by websites you visit. We also use related technologies, including local storage, session storage, and pixel tags, under the same name in this policy. They allow the platform to remember information about your visit such as authentication, language, and cart contents.

sections.title: 2. How we use cookies
sections.content: mustaphaukizuru.com uses cookies for four purposes: keeping you signed in, remembering your preferences, measuring how the platform performs, and understanding which content and campaigns are reaching the right audiences. We do not sell personal information.

sections.title: 3. Strictly necessary cookies
sections.content: These cookies enable core functions: authentication, account session continuity, cart and checkout integrity, CSRF protection, and load-balancing. The platform cannot function without them, so they are always on. Examples: mu_session, mu_csrf, mu_cookie_consent_v1.

sections.title: 4. Functional cookies
sections.content: These remember non-essential preferences across visits, including language, time zone, theme, saved filters, and consent decisions. You can disable these and the site will still work; you will simply need to set those preferences again on each visit.

sections.title: 5. Analytics cookies
sections.content: Anonymous, aggregate usage measurement so we know which pages load slowly, which CTAs convert, and where visitors drop off. IP addresses are pseudonymised, retention is capped at 26 months, and we never resell this data. You can opt out and the platform will continue to function normally.

sections.title: 6. Marketing cookies
sections.content: Used to measure the performance of campaigns on LinkedIn, Meta, Google, X, and similar platforms, and to tailor recommendations. You can disable these completely; you may then see less relevant advertising elsewhere on the web, but nothing on this site changes.

sections.title: 7. Third-party services
sections.content: Some pages embed services that may set their own cookies, including payment processors (Mercado Pago, PayPal), Google Sign-In, and embedded media. These services are governed by their own privacy and cookie policies; we link to them where relevant.

sections.title: 8. Your choices
sections.content: When you first visit the site we ask you to accept all, reject optional cookies, or fine-tune by category. You can change your decision any time using the 'Cookie preferences' link in the footer. Resetting will re-show the consent banner so you can choose again.

sections.title: 9. Browser controls
sections.content: Most browsers let you block or delete cookies via Settings → Privacy. Doing so site-wide may break parts of this and other sites. We honour the Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal where it is sent; it is treated as an explicit reject-all for optional categories.

sections.title: 10. Updates to this policy
sections.content: When we materially change how we use cookies, for example by adding a new analytics partner, we increment the policy version (CONSENT_VERSION) which triggers the consent banner again so you can review and re-consent. The 'Last updated' date above always reflects the most recent revision.

sections.title: 11. Contact
sections.content: For cookie or privacy questions, write to hello@mustaphaukizuru.com. We respond to verifiable requests under the GDPR, ePrivacy Directive, and Mexico's Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP) within 20 business days.

nda.title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
nda.intro: Before you can see the milestones, files and conversation for {{project}}, please review and accept this agreement. It protects both sides: what you share with us and what we build for you.
nda.parties: This agreement is between Mustapha Ukizuru ("Consultant") and you, the client named on this project ("Client"). Together, "the Parties".

clauses.title: 1. Confidential information
clauses.body: Confidential Information means any non-public business, technical, financial or personal information disclosed by either Party in connection with this project, including briefs, source code, designs, credentials, data, pricing, deliverables and drafts shared through this portal.

clauses.title: 2. Obligations
clauses.body: Each Party will use the other's Confidential Information only for this project, protect it with at least the care it uses for its own confidential material, and disclose it only to people who need it for the project and are bound by equivalent obligations.

clauses.title: 3. Exclusions
clauses.body: Information is not confidential if it is or becomes public without breach, was already known to the receiving Party, is independently developed, or is lawfully obtained from a third party. Disclosure required by law is permitted after reasonable notice where allowed.

clauses.title: 4. Deliverables and ownership
clauses.body: Deliverables are Confidential Information until the project is completed and paid in full, after which ownership transfers as described in the Terms of Service. The Consultant may keep generic know-how and reusable components that contain no Client data.

clauses.title: 5. Term
clauses.body: These obligations start when you accept and continue for three (3) years after the project closes. Trade secrets stay protected for as long as they remain trade secrets.

clauses.title: 6. Return or deletion
clauses.body: On request, or when the project is purged from this portal, each Party will delete or return the other's Confidential Information, keeping only copies required by law or routine backups.

clauses.title: 7. General
clauses.body: No licence or partnership is created by this agreement. It is governed by the same law and venue as the Terms of Service. Accepting below records your name, the time, IP address and browser as your electronic signature.
